reviewed_boundary.scope:
1. Scope and Applicability

Candidate authored methodology for a new complete manually pushed open platform cart with welded tubular/profile steel frame and handle, finished wood-derived-board deck with beech-grain surface, two TPE-tyred swivel castors with wheel locks and two TPE-tyred fixed castors with ball-bearing hubs. Manufacture starts with received steel stock and finished panel/castor modules, includes actual stock cutting/forming, frame welding, shot-blast preparation and solvent-free powder coating, then assembly, controlled complete-cart acceptance, calibrated empty net weighing and release. The manufacturer fetra2500 is a configuration example, not a compulsory geometry, rated capacity or process recipe.

Narrower than CPC49930. Exclude two-wheel hand trucks, wheelbarrows, shelf/ladder/folding carts, hydraulic pallet trucks, towable industrial trailers, aluminium/stainless/plastic frame routes, four-swivel or unbraked castor variants, powered propulsion and operating material-handling service. A purchased complete frame/cart assembly route omits material forming/welding and cannot silently reuse this manufacture gate. Existing product/scaffold identity is not promoted merely from classification. Scientific review is pending; translation alignment and automated checks do not approve methodology.
reviewed_boundary.covered: Complete empty welded-steel wood-derived-board-deck manual four-wheel cart of declared2swivel/2fixed locked-castor architecture
reviewed_boundary.excluded: Other cart frame/deck/castor families, pallet lifting/powered vehicles, incomplete kits and operating transport
reviewed_boundary.market_state: New complete accepted empty cart at declared manufacturing release gate

semantic_boundary.decision: New complete nonpowered manual four-wheel open platform cart, welded tubular/profile steel frame/handle, wood-derived-board beech-grain deck, two TPE swivel castors with wheel locks and two TPE fixed castors. Foreground stock sawing/forming, frame welding, shot-blast/powder coating, supplied panel/castor assembly and controlled complete-cart acceptance/net weighing/release. Conditional weld consumables, gas heating/emissions and shipment protection use actual records. Narrower than49930; excludes two-wheel hand trucks, wheelbarrows, shelf/folding carts, hydraulic pallet trucks, powered carts and operating material handling. No overlapping material cart PCR found.
semantic_boundary.rationale: Distinct stock-to-complete-cart manufacturing boundary requires steel cutting/forming/welding, dry blast/powder coating and declared wood-board/TPE castor integration and empty net acceptance. Excludes alternative frame/deck/castor architectures, powered/hydraulic and purchased whole-frame assembly. No material complete manual cart duplicate found; not identity creation solely for CPC leaf.

evidence_limitations: No actual serial net M, stock grade/board formulation, supplier module inclusions, measured quantities, welding procedure, powder/SDS/abrasive/heat route, gas or emission observations were obtained. Mandatory actual acquisition and scientific review remain.

fetra product and production pages are one manufacturer evidence family. They support the specified architecture and process route, not a universal recipe, empirical quantity ranges, mandatory gas burner or a guarantee-as-lifetime assumption.
Foreground stock-to-cart manufacture is not complete cradle-to-gate; public electricity use leaves upstream technology/provider/voltage unspecified.
